title: workspace-manifest unified schema
description: Kind-polymorphic manifest schema unifying task manifests and capsule traces. DAG-linking via parent_capsule_digest + fork_root_digest. Status space: pending | confirmed | invalidated | running | cancelled.

id.description: Stable identity for this manifest record.

kind.description: Polymorphic discriminator / routing hint: 'task' for task manifests, 'capsule' for capsule traces. Doubles as routing hint for workspace-file agents.

status.description: Execution status agreed in the 7/29 Lyra discussion.

agent_id.description: The agent identity that authored this record.

digest.description: Canonical sha256 hex of the canonicalized record body (JCS RFC 8785 + NFC strict).

parent_capsule_digest.description: DAG-link: digest of the parent capsule this record extends or mutates. null for root records.

fork_root_digest.description: DAG-link: digest of the root of the fork lineage. Identical across a fork family; null when no fork.

effect_manifest.description: Capsule-only: attested effects (pre_state / operation / post_state / expected_verdict).
